title: Marrakech Property Market Cools in Q2 2026 — What Buyers and Sellers Need to Know
body:
Marrakech property transaction volumes fell 18% in Q2 2026 vs the same period in 2025, with average days-on-market for premium properties rising from 45 to 78 days. Rising rates, inventory overhang and currency movements are the primary drivers.

Where Value Remains

The Palmeraie luxury villa segment and medina riads with proven rental income are holding value best. Cash buyers have a genuine negotiating window — sellers who listed at 2024 peak prices are increasingly flexible.

Data from the Marrakech Notarial Chamber.
